translations.en:
Welcome!
Can I take your order?

Jisu! I want to go
to Hongdae...
Wow... there are so many people!

Excuse me, how do
I get to Hongdae?

Emma! What are
you doing here?

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 매운 거 못 먹어요... 근데 맛있어요!!

translations.en:
I can't eat spicy food...
but it's delicious!!

I want to eat that!
But is it spicy?
Is it okay to eat here?
Wow, the convenience store is this big?

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 어? 혹시... 지수 오빠 민준 씨예요?

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 진짜 맛있어요! 한국 편의점 너무 좋아요.

translations.en:
It's really delicious!
I love Korean convenience stores.

How about this?
Triangle gimbap and ramen!

bubbles.speaker: minjun
bubbles.korean: 응, 돼. 한국 편의점은 다 이래.

translations.en:
Yeah. All Korean
convenience stores are like this.

Yes, I'm Minjun.
You're Emma, right?

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 천천히 말해주실 수 있어요? 한국어 공부 중이에요.

translations.en:
Could you speak slowly?
I'm studying Korean.

bubbles.speaker: jisu
bubbles.korean: 여기 진짜 맛있어. 삼겹살 먹어 본 적 있어?

translations.en:
This place is great.
Have you ever had samgyeopsal?
Sophie, do you know Korean songs?
I love this song so much!!
It's my first time at a noraebang!
Of course! I know them all!
I've been here more than ten times!
I love K-pop so much too!
Wow, this place is so interesting!
Go ahead. Say "Please give me a discount."

I now know how to ask
"How much for all of it"!

Thank you! It's delicious!
A little more, please!

bubbles.speaker: minjun
bubbles.korean: 한국 전통 시장이야. 뭐든 다 있어.

translations.en:
This is a Korean traditional market.
They have everything.
Excuse me... please give me a discount!

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean:
K-뷰티 진짜 좋아요!
피부에 다 좋아요!

translations.en:
I really love K-beauty!
Everything is good for your skin!

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 제 피부 타입에 맞는 거 추천해 주세요.

translations.en:
Please recommend something
for my skin type.
Have you tried this? It's really good!

This place is great.
K-beauty is the best!

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 이거... 친구한테 선물하려고요. 어떤 게 좋아요?

translations.en:
This... I'm planning to give it as a gift.
Which one is good?
What's good here? Everything looks interesting.
Is your skin dry or oily?

I love this kind of thing.
I love that we're all here together.

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean:
한국에 온 지 얼마 안 됐는데...
이미 너무 좋아요.

translations.en:
I haven't been in Korea long...
but I already love it so much.

Korean fried chicken...
it's really more delicious than I expected!!
Wow, Hangang! It's my first time here!
The weather today is so great!
It's faster than you expected, right?

You're the new student, right?
Would you like to introduce yourself?

Today is my first class.
I'm a little nervous.

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 다음엔 혼자 탈 수 있을 것 같아요!

translations.en: I think I can ride it alone next time!
Can I get a refill on these side dishes?
This place is famous for sundubu jjigae.
You can get it to go. Take some next time.
Oh, there are clams in it?
Can you make it less spicy?
Let's meet at a café in Hongdae!
Want to watch a movie with Sophie?
I'll never be late next time!
Emma, what are you doing this weekend?
What should we do next time?
Sure! What time should we meet?
I might be a little late...
How do I get to Gyeongbokgung?
I managed even without a map!
How long does it take on foot?
Next time I should ask to see the map.
I watched it all last night!
What time do new episodes come out?
Emma, are you watching any dramas lately?
Yes! Have you seen this one?
You can watch it on Netflix.
What's the weather like there tomorrow?
Emma, what's the weather like today?
The weather's nice! Shall we take a walk?
Really? I should bring an umbrella!

bubbles.speaker: pharmacist
bubbles.korean: 매운 거 안 먹는 게 나아요.

translations.en: It's better not to eat spicy food.
Yeah, I got plenty of rest and got better!
My head hurts. And I have a fever.

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 요즘 한국 카페 사진에 빠져 있어요.

translations.en: I've been obsessed with taking photos of Korean cafés lately.
Let's do a café tour together next time.

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 저는 폰 카메라 별로예요. 미러리스 써요.

translations.en:
I don't really like phone cameras.
I use a mirrorless.
What would be good as a gift?
I want to come here again!
The photos turned out so well!
Sure! Did it turn out well?
Let's go to Changdeokgung next time!
How have you been doing lately?
Let's stay in touch, for sure!
Emma, what did you do yesterday?

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 배달 안 했어요. 다음엔 꼭 먹을 거예요!

translations.en: I want to go to Hangang often too.
I went to the Hangang River! I took photos.

bubbles.speaker: minjun
bubbles.korean: 줄 서 있는 거 보면 맛있나 봐.

translations.en: What do you think you'll order?
It was delicious just as I thought!
It seems like it'll be delicious!
I have to write a report too.
You can't look at your phone.
I need to rest a little...
You have to do a little more!
It's next week. I have to study!
Emma, what do you think of Korean food?
It's really delicious! Especially the spicy stuff!
Have you eaten seafood in Jeju?
Yes, I've climbed it. It was tough but great.
Recommend other dramas to me too!
What drama are you watching lately?
I watched it too! It's really fun, right?
I don't know. I'm looking forward to it!
I want to go to a concert together!
Really? That's such a beautiful phrase.
Let's buy them right when they open!

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 네, 효과 좋다고 들었어요. 후기도 진짜 좋아요.

translations.en: What about this? It seems like it'll suit your skin.
Yes, it's really good for hydration.
I like it! I'll buy this.
Wow, my skin feels so moisturized!
How about hiking on the weekend?
Health is the most important thing!
What do you do in Korea?
Sounds perfect! I'm looking forward to it!
Yes! I do yoga. I also run.
I ride a bike at the Hangang River!
Hongdae is really a great neighborhood!
Right! There are many cafés and great restaurants.
I live near Hongdae! It's a studio apartment.

bubbles.speaker: sophie
bubbles.korean: 에마, 한국에 온 지 얼마나 됐어요?

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 거의 다 됐어요, 이제 자신 있어요!

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 네! 한국어 더 열심히 할 거예요!

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 이 표현 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요?

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 거의 맞아요! 이렇게 하면 더 자연스러워요.

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 한국 음식 중에 뭐가 제일 좋아요?

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 이 순간 절대 못 잊을 거예요!

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 저 한국에 더 있고 싶긴 해요.

bubbles.speaker: emma
bubbles.korean: 힘들 때 포기 안 하길 잘했어요!
